The proposed answer of 30 is wrong; the correct count is 60.

Each handshake is between one witch and one sorcerer. There are 6 witches, and each shakes hands with all 10 sorcerers, so there are 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes. No other handshakes occur, because witches don't shake with witches and sorcerers don't shake with sorcerers.

The solution's mistake is dividing by 2. Counting from the witches' side gives each handshake exactly once, so the total is already 60. Counting from the sorcerers' side gives the same 60 handshakes again, not additional ones. Dividing by 2 would only be correct if the two counts had been added together to get 120.

VERDICT: REJECT
